           About
         CR                                  POWER
                                              關於華潤電力




China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited (the“Company” or “CR
Power”) is one of the most efficient and profitable integrated energy
companies in China, which invests, develops, operates and manages
coal-fired power plants, wind farms, photovoltaic power plants,
hydro-electric plants and other clean and renewable energy projects in
the more affluent regions or regions with abundant coal resources in
China. Its business also covers distributed energy, power sales, intelligent
energy, coal mining, and other areas.                                          華潤電力控股有限公司（「本公司」或「華潤電力」）為中國效率最高、
                                                                               效益最好的綜合能源公司之一，主要在中國較富裕或煤炭資源豐富的地區

                     Refining from the China University of Petroleum and a Master of Business
                     Administration (“MBA”) Degree from the University of Texas in the United
                     States of America.

PROSPECTS FOR 2020                                                     對 2020 年的展望
In January 2020, the “COVID-19 virus” epidemic outbreak spread         2020 年 1 月， 國 內 發 生 新 型 冠 狀 病 毒 疫
across China. The government implemented a number of measures          情，政府實施多項措施，包括延長農曆新
to curb the spread of the virus, such as extending the Lunar New       年假期、人員隔離、推遲復工等，遏制病
Year holiday, quarantining personnel, and delaying resumption          毒的傳播。1、2 月份由於工廠、企業等延
of work. Due to the delayed resumption of operation in factories       遲復工，電力需求在低位徘徊。隨着 2 月
and enterprises in January and February, power demand remained         尾、3 月各地企業陸續復工復產，電力需
at low levels. With enterprises across China gradually returning to    求會逐步回升。為應對疫情對經濟增長的
work and resuming production at the end of February and March,         負面影響，中央政府將採取一系列措施，
it is expected that power demand will gradually recover. In order      減 稅 降 費， 減 輕 企 業 負 擔， 拉 動 經 濟 增
to deal with the negative impacts of the epidemic on economic          長。
growth, the central government will adopt a series of measures,
such as reducing taxes and fees, reducing the burden on enterprises

     high standards of safety, performance and corporate governance.         企業管治方面達到高標準。

      4      CRITICAL ACCOUNTING ESTIMATES AND                                       4   關鍵會計估計及判斷
             JUDGEMENTS
             Estimates and judgments are continually evaluated and are                   估計及判斷乃根據過往經驗及其他因
             based on historical experience and other factors, including                 素（包括在有關情況下對未來事件的
             expectations of future events that are believed to be                       合理預期）作持續評估。
             reasonable under the circumstances.

             The Group makes estimates and assumptions concerning the                    本集團對未來作出多項估計及假設。
             future. The resulting accounting estimates will, by definition,             根據定義，就此產生的會計估計甚少
             seldom equal the related actual results. The estimates and                  相等於相關實際結果。具有導致於下
